remarks: Welcome to your new home! This 3-level townhouse boasts convenience and updates. Dive into relaxation with an in-ground pool in the complex. Step inside to discover updated kitchen and bathrooms, ensuring modern comfort. With 3 bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with an ensuite bath, ample space awaits. Enjoy entertaining in the spacious living room with sliders to the deck, or gather in the dining area accommodating 10-12 guests. Need more space? The lower level offers a full bathroom and an extra room perfect for an office or playroom. Move right in and start living your best life!
